Set 03 of 07

Matcha Latte

Sage marble, poured cream

kr 440

Made to order in Copenhagen · VAT included · delivery & returns

Run 01 · twelve made · opens October

Finish
Satin marble
Shape
Almond · Medium
Wear
2–3 weeks

Two colours go on wet and get dragged through each other once. Once is the whole rule — a second pass turns the marble to mud, and there is no way back from it except starting the nail again.

Because the drag is different every time, this is the set where the ten nails least resemble each other. People either want that or they want Lily Blanc.

  • Ten hand-finished nails, plus two spares
  • Twelve sizes in the box — no fitting needed
  • Glue, adhesive tabs, a mini file and a cuticle stick
  • Reusable: soaked off gently, a set goes back on four or five times
